title: Show HN: Wyzer Programming Language
summary: Wyzer is a statically typed, compiled programming language designed for distributed systems safety, combining choreographic programming with the Perceus memory model. Created as an alternative to Rust, it addresses the gap where Rust provides memory safety but lacks guarantees against distributed deadlocks.
problem_solved: Provides guaranteed safety against distributed deadlocks in concurrent/distributed systems where existing languages like Rust fail to offer comprehensive safety guarantees.
why_valuable: It bridges the gap between memory safety and distributed system safety, offering a unified programming model that eliminates an entire class of concurrency bugs.
